simple.summary: כָּנַשׁ (kânash) means to assemble First listed occurrence: Dan 3 2.

definitions.full: H3673. kenash [ כְּנַשׁ ] verb gather ( ᵑ7 id. ; Old Aramaic Palmyrene בנש Lzb 298 ; Syriac ; see also Biblical Hebrew [ כָּנַס ); — Pe`al Infinitive , לְמִכְנַשׁ , followed by ל accusative of person Dan 3:2 . Hithpa. Participle plural מִתְכַּנְּשִׁין (were) assembled Dan 3:3 , 27 .
